ideas.title: The Impact of Social Services Cuts on Vulnerable Populations
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of proposed cuts to social services on vulnerable populations in Minnesota
ideas.angle: Follow the money: tracking the allocation of funds for social services
questions: What are the specific cuts proposed?
How will these cuts affect vulnerable populations?
ideas.insight: The proposed cuts to social services could have a significant impact on vulnerable populations in Minnesota, and it's essential to track the allocation of funds to understand the effects.
